events.event_hazard: Tropical cyclone (Cyclone Aila), storm surge, and flooding
affected_locations: Dakshin Bedkashi Union, Koyra Upazila, Khulna District, Bangladesh
key_impacts: Killed 33 people in Dakshin Bedkashi Union
Washed away 3,520 houses and partially damaged 1,800 in Dakshin Bedkashi Union
Coastal embankment in Dakshin Bedkashi breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged
Villages in Dakshin Bedkashi were inundated twice daily by tidal water until polder rehabilitation in 2013
Across Bangladesh, 243,191 houses were washed away and 370,587 were partially damaged
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65 knots and a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, cyclone Aila killed 33 people, washed away 3520 houses, partially damaged 1800, and inundated almost the entire union.
The storm surge overtopped the coastal embankment, breached it in six places and damaged 20.55 km of embankment.
